sloka: तथा तु तारा करुणम् रुदंतीभर्तुः समीपे सह वानरीभिः ।व्यवस्यत प्रायम् अनिन्द्य वर्णाउपोपवेष्टुम् भुवि यत्र वाली ॥४-२०-२६॥
transliteration: tathā tu tārā karuṇam rudaṁtībhartuḥ samīpe saha vānarībhiḥ ।vyavasyata prāyam anindya varṇāupopaveṣṭum bhuvi yatra vālī ॥4-20-26॥

translations.english: So Tara of blameless hue, weeping piteously beside her lord with the vanara women, resolved to fast unto death and to sit down there on the ground where Vali lay.
